founded_year.en: 1956 (Mar. 3, the Daehan Stock Exchange, predecessor of the Korea Stock Exchange, established); the present-day Korea Exchange was formed Jan. 27, 2005 by consolidating KSE, the KOSDAQ market and the Korea Futures Exchange (KOFEX), initially named the Korea Stock and Futures Exchange, renamed Korea Exchange on Feb. 4, 2008
founded_year.detail:
"Established in 1956" 是 KRX 官方 CEO Message 页给出的成立年份表述，对应的是其前身大韩
证券交易所/韩国证券交易所（KSE）的设立年份，而不是现行统一法人的设立年份——现行 KRX
法人实体是 2005 年三方合并的产物，2008 年才改用「韩国交易所」这个名称。这条历史链条与
现在的多板块结构（KOSPI/KOSDAQ/KONEX）是同一件事的两面，见文件头注释。

circuit_breaker.zh: 指数级三阶段熔断（Circuit Breakers）：第一阶段KOSPI（或KOSDAQ）指数较前日下跌8%以上（且持续1分钟），全市场暂停交易20分钟；第二阶段较前日下跌15%以上且较第一触发点再跌1%以上，熔断后以单一价格集合竞价10分钟恢复连续竞价；第三阶段较前日下跌20%以上且较第二触发点再跌1%以上，当日收市，所有申报（含撤单）不可再提交
circuit_breaker.en: Three-phase index-level circuit breaker: Phase 1 — KOSPI (KOSDAQ) index falls 8% or more from the previous day (lasting one minute), entire market suspended 20 minutes; Phase 2 — falls 15% or more plus an additional 1% fall from the Phase-1 trigger, single-price call auction for 10 minutes after activation then resumes continuous auction; Phase 3 — falls 20% or more plus an additional 1% fall from the Phase-2 trigger, market closes for the day, no quotations (including cancellations) may be submitted

volatility_interruption.zh: 个股级波动性中断（Volatility Interruption, VI），分动态VI与静态VI：连续竞价阶段VI触发后转为2分钟单一价格集合竞价；触发价 = 基准价 ± (基准价 × 触发比率)，KOSPI200成份股/ETF等常规交易时段动态VI比率±3%、静态VI比率±10%，其余品种动态VI比率±6%
volatility_interruption.en: Individual-issue Volatility Interruption (VI), split into Dynamic VI and Static VI: when triggered during continuous auction, trading switches to a 2-minute single-price call auction; activation price = reference price ± (reference price × activation rate); for KOSPI 200 constituents/ETFs etc. the dynamic VI rate is ±3% and static VI rate ±10% during the regular session, while other issues use a ±6% dynamic rate
volatility_interruption.detail: 此外还有「sidecar」机制（KOSPI200期货价格5分钟内单方向变动达5%，或KOSDAQ150期货价格变动6%以上且KOSDAQ150指数同向变动3%以上时，暂停程序化交易挂单5分钟），是与VI并行的另一套稳定机制，未单独设字段，写在此处备注，不计入zh/en正文（其涉及的具体比例本次未逐一配 quote）。

trading_halt_mechanism.zh: 个股停牌情形包括：上市公司披露重大信息后停牌30分钟；被指定为不实披露法人当日停牌；因传闻/报道引发交易量激增，须待澄清公告后方可复牌；公司未按要求答复问询（KOSPI从逾期到披露、KOSDAQ从逾期到披露后再加30分钟）；交易所认为有必要保护投资者时停牌1天；此外还有因退市事由、股票证书变更、结算会员未按期交收等其他停牌情形
trading_halt_mechanism.en: Individual-issue halts include: 30-minute suspension after a listed company discloses material information; one-day suspension upon designation as an unfaithful-disclosure corporation; suspension pending a clarifying announcement when a volume surge is likely due to rumors/news; suspension when a company fails to respond to a disclosure inquiry (KOSPI: from missed deadline to disclosure; KOSDAQ: from missed deadline to 30 minutes after disclosure); one-day suspension when the Exchange deems it necessary for investor protection; plus other grounds such as delisting causes, stock-certificate changes, and clearing-member settlement failures

matching_principle.zh: 连续交易阶段采用个别竞价、价格优先与时间优先原则：较低卖价优先于较高卖价，较高买价优先于较低买价，同价申报按接收先后排序；但在单一价格集合竞价中，若成交价落在涨跌停价，则不适用时间优先，改按数量优先分配成交（大额申报优先于小额申报，同数量再按时间优先）
matching_principle.en: Continuous trading applies individual auction with price and time priority: a lower ask has priority over a higher ask, a higher bid has priority over a lower bid, and among same-priced orders the one received earlier has priority; however, in a single-price (call) auction, if the determined price is at the daily price limit, time priority is not applied — quantity priority is used instead (larger orders matched before smaller ones, with time priority applied among orders of equal quantity)

sources.title: Regulation ‧ Derivatives ‧ Method of Trade Execution（KRX官网英文版）

matching_principle.quote: Individual auction has price and time priorities for the orders to execute. That is, a lower ask has the priority over a higher ask and a higher bid has the priority over a lower bid. Among the orders with same prices, the order received earlier has the priority over those received later. However, in case of single price auction, if the price is determined at the upper or lower price limit, the time priority is not applied to those orders at the price limit. Orders are matched based on quantity priority where the larger order has the priority over the smaller order and the execution quantity is allocated from the larger ones to the smaller ones until the whole quantity is matched. Among the orders with same quantity, time priority is applied.

order_types.zh: 限价申报（指定价格与数量）、市价申报（仅指定数量，以市场最优价成交）、限价转收盘价申报（收盘前连续交易阶段未成交的限价申报转为市价申报并入收盘集合竞价）、即时可执行限价申报（申报时的最优价格即固定为成交价的一种市价类申报，未成交余量按最初最优价挂单排队）；另可附加FOK（Fill or Kill，全部成交或全部取消）、IOC（Immediate or Cancel，部分成交、剩余取消）两种条件
order_types.en: Limit order (price and quantity both specified); Market order (only quantity specified, matched at the best available price); Limit-to-market-on-close order (an unexecuted limit order at the end of continuous trading converts to a market order and joins the closing single-price auction); Immediately executable limit order (a market-order variant whose matching price is fixed at the best price at input time, with any unexecuted balance queued in the order book at that initial best price); orders may also carry a Fill-or-Kill (FOK) or Immediate-or-Cancel (IOC) condition

sources.title: Regulation ‧ Derivatives ‧ Order Types（KRX官网英文版）

order_types.quote: The limit order is an order of which the price and quantity are specified. It is matched at prices better than the specified price or at the specified price. The market order is an order placed to buy or sell at the best available price. Whereas the quantity of order is specified, the price is not. The limit-to-market-on-close order is the limit order placed with an instruction to convert it to the market order and include it in the single price auction at the time when the closing price is determined, if the order remains unexecuted until the end of the continuous auction on a given trading day. The immediately executable limit order is the market order in the sense that its price is not specified, but it is different from the market order in that the matching price is fixed at the price that is the best at the time of input. Unexecuted best orders are queued in the order book at the initial best price. Fill or Kill : Orders are that all of the orders are cancelled, if not executed immediately after the enter thereof Immediate or Cancel : Orders are that any of the orders possible to execute is executed and the remaining order are cancelled

circuit_breaker.zh: 衍生品市场本身未单独设立熔断机制，而是与现货市场的三阶段指数熔断（具体档位见顶层 circuit_breaker 字段）联动：现货市场熔断第三阶段（触发全市场收市）当日触发后，包括当晚夜盘在内的全部衍生品交易当天不开展；夜盘期间因标的股指本身不交易、无价格波动，熔断机制在夜盘无法被触发
circuit_breaker.en: The derivatives market has no independent circuit breaker of its own; it is instead linked to the cash market's three-phase index circuit breaker (see the top-level circuit_breaker field): once the cash market's Phase-3 circuit breaker (market closed for the day) is triggered, all derivatives trading — including that day's Night-Session — is not conducted; during the Night-Session itself, the circuit breaker cannot be triggered at all because the underlying stock index does not trade and therefore has no price movement at night
circuit_breaker.detail: 受控词表 circuit_breaker_type 各选项均以「熔断机制本身独立存在」为设计语境；本字段的真实情况是衍生品市场完全没有自己的熔断判定，只是被动跟随现货市场的指数级熔断结果，这里借用 index_level 仅取「触发基础是指数」的含义，与顶层字段共享同一枚举值，不代表衍生品市场另有一套独立的指数级判定逻辑——这是裁剪后字段集合复用现货枚举时一处不完全贴合，做法参照 hk-hkex.derivatives.circuit_breaker 的既有先例。

However, if trading in the stock market is terminated due to the activation of CB stage 3 during the regular session, night trading for all derivatives that open on the same day, including FICC derivatives, is not conducted.

volatility_interruption.zh: 实时价格限制（Real-time Price Limits）：约束新成交价相对上一笔成交价的最大偏离幅度（区别于以当日基准价为准的每日涨跌停，见 price_limits），适用于夜盘可交易的10只品种中的8只；夜盘该限制较常规时段放宽一倍：KOSPI200期货/Mini-KOSPI200期货/KOSDAQ150期货及美元期货常规±1.0%、夜盘±2.0%（期货价差同幅度）；3年期国债期货常规±0.5%、夜盘±1.0%；10年期国债期货常规±0.9%、夜盘±1.8%；KOSPI200期权（含周期权）另按《衍生品市场业务规程施行细则》附件25单独规定
volatility_interruption.en: Real-time Price Limits: constrain how far a new trade price may deviate from the immediately preceding trade price (distinct from the daily price_limits, which are set against the day's base price); applied to 8 of the 10 products tradable in the Night-Session. The night-session limit is doubled versus the regular session: KOSPI 200/Mini-KOSPI 200/KOSDAQ 150 Futures and USD Futures are ±1.0% (regular) / ±2.0% (night) — the same for futures spreads; 3-Year KTB Futures ±0.5% (regular) / ±1.0% (night); 10-Year KTB Futures ±0.9% (regular) / ±1.8% (night); KOSPI 200 Options (including Weekly Options) are separately governed by Annex 25 of the Enforcement Rules of the Derivatives Market Business Regulations

trading_halt_mechanism.zh: 分强制暂停（Compulsory Suspension）与裁量暂停（Discretionary Suspension）两类：强制暂停即现货市场熔断触发时联动暂停衍生品交易（见 circuit_breaker），夜盘不适用此类暂停；裁量暂停指交易所/会员系统故障或异常交易情形导致的暂停，夜盘同样适用但触发条件因夜盘特性有所调整（如现货系统故障超过10分钟导致指数成分股大量无法交易的情形，因夜盘不计算股指而不适用；单一股票期货期权因标的股票停牌而暂停的情形，因该类产品夜盘本身不交易而不适用；交易所认定存在或可能存在异常交易情形时的裁量暂停则夜盘同样适用）；暂停后恢复交易同样以集合竞价方式确定首笔价格（见 opening_mechanism）
trading_halt_mechanism.en: Two categories: Compulsory Suspension — triggered in lockstep with the cash market's circuit breaker (see circuit_breaker), and not applicable to the Night-Session; and Discretionary Suspension — for Exchange/member system failures or abnormal trading conditions, which does apply to the Night-Session but with trigger conditions adjusted for the night session's characteristics (e.g. a cash-market system failure lasting over 10 minutes that leaves a large number of an index's constituents untradeable does not apply at night, since the index is not calculated then; a single-stock futures/options halt triggered by suspension of the underlying stock does not apply at night, since those products are not traded at night; Exchange-discretion halts for actual or potential abnormal trading conditions do apply at night). Trading resumes via the same call-auction mechanism used to set the opening/closing price (see opening_mechanism)

trading_halt_mechanism.quote: The compulsory suspension refers to cases where the market can be operated but trading is suspended as needed, and does not apply to night trading. This is because there is no price fluctuation in the stock index during night hours, so circuit breaker (CB) cannot be triggered. ⋯ The discretionary suspension refers to suspension due to the impossibility of market operation or trading of a specific product, and includes Exchange and member system failures. The discretionary suspension also applies to night trading, with some exceptions. ⋯ When a system failure occurs in the stock market for more than 10 minutes and trading is not possible for a certain number of stock index constituents

block_trade.zh: 协商大宗交易（Negotiated Block Trades）：买卖双方自行协商标的、价格、数量后经会员向交易所申请撮合成交，适用于绝大多数衍生品（例外：KOSPI200波动率指数期货、5年期国债期货、美元期权、瘦肉猪期货及其对应价差交易被排除在外）；另设期货转现货（EFP, Exchange of Futures for Physicals）交易方式，仅美元期货可用，且不适用于夜盘
block_trade.en: Negotiated Block Trades: counterparties privately negotiate the issue, price and quantity, then file the trade with the Exchange via a member for execution; available for the great majority of derivatives (exclusions: KOSPI 200 Volatility Index futures, 5-Year KTB futures, USD options, Lean Hog futures, and the corresponding spread trades). A separate Exchange of Futures for Physicals (EFP) mechanism also exists, available only for USD Futures and not applicable during the Night-Session

Trading parties negotiate the transaction details such as the issue, price and quantity and file an application with the exchange via members to execute the block trade. The following derivatives are availiable for negotiated block trading : 1. Equity derivatives trades. Provided that KOSPI 200 volatility index futures trades are excluded; 2. Interest futures trades. Provided that 5-year KTB futures trades are exclueded; 3. Currency derivatives trades. Provided that USD options trades are exclueded; 4. Commodity futures trades. Provided that Lean Hog futures trades are exclueded; 5. Futures spread trades. Provided that KOSPI 200 volatility index futures spread trades, 5-year KTB futures spread trades, Inter-KTB futures spread trades and Lean Hog futures spread trades are excluded ⋯ EFP trading is a method of block trading for the convenience of the block traders like institutional investors who intend to trade a large amount of EFPs avoiding sudden fluctuations in the market price from the large volume. ⋯ EFPs are available for USD futures. * EFPs are not applicable during night session

margin_practice_note.zh: 按付款方分两级：客户保证金（投资者→会员）与结算会员保证金（会员→交易所）；引入夜盘后，结算会员保证金由原先每日算一次改为每日算两次（常规、夜盘收盘后各计算一次），缴纳截止时间相应缩短一小时（原T+1日12:00 → 现11:00）；若夜盘重算所得应缴保证金较前一常规时段末的保证金「显著更高」（增幅达120%以上，或增量达500亿韩元以上），须在11:00截止前补缴该重算金额
margin_practice_note.en: Margin is split by payer into two tiers: customer margin (investor to member) and (clearing) member margin (member to Exchange). With the introduction of the Night-Session, member margin is now calculated twice each trading day (once after the regular session closes and once after the night session closes) instead of once, and the deposit deadline is shortened by one hour (from 12:00 to 11:00 on T+1 day). If the recalculated margin required after the night session is significantly higher than the amount at the end of the prior regular session — by 120% or more, or by KRW 50 billion or more — the account holder must deposit the recalculated amount by the 11:00 deadline

delisting_conditions.zh: KOSPI市场设「管理股指定」与「退市」两级：管理股指定情形含未按期提交定期报告、审计意见为「保留/否定/无法表示意见」、资本侵蚀率50%以上、少数股东少于200人或持股比例低于5%、半年平均月成交量低于流通股1%、外部董事人数不足、不实披露累计扣分达10分以上、营收低于300亿韩元（2026年前为50亿、2026年为100亿、2027年为200亿韩元的过渡门槛，2027年起若最近年度平均市值达1000亿韩元以上可豁免）、市值连续30个交易日低于500亿韩元（2025年前为50亿、2026上半年为200亿、2026下半年为300亿韩元的过渡门槛）等；上述情形连续两年未解决或触发即时退市条款（如连续记录修正审计意见、逾期10日未交业务报告）则直接退市
delisting_conditions.en: The KOSPI market uses a two-tier system — designation as an administrative issue, then delisting. Administrative-issue triggers include failure to submit periodic reports on time, a qualified/adverse/disclaimer audit opinion, a capital impairment ratio of 50% or more, fewer than 200 general shareholders or under 5% shareholding ratio, average monthly trading volume below 1% of free float for a half-year, an insufficient number of outside directors, 10+ accumulated penalty points for disclosure violations, sales below KRW 30 billion (phased-in thresholds of KRW 5bn until 2026, KRW 10bn in 2027, KRW 20bn in 2028), or market capitalization below KRW 50 billion for 30 consecutive trading days (phased-in thresholds of KRW 5bn until 2025, KRW 20bn in H1 2026, KRW 30bn in H2 2026); persistence of these conditions for two consecutive years, or immediate-delisting triggers (e.g. consecutive modified audit opinions, failure to submit a business report within 10 days of the deadline), lead directly to delisting

membership_structure.zh: 持有FSCMA第12(1)条投资交易/投资经纪业务牌照的机构方可申请会员资格；会员按市场范围与产品种类分七类（证券会员/股票证券会员/集合投资证券会员/债务证券会员/衍生品会员/股票衍生品会员/货币利率衍生品会员），并按是否自行承担结算责任分为结算会员与交易会员；财务门槛举例：证券会员+衍生品会员需股本至少400亿韩元且净资本比率100%以上，证券会员+股票衍生品会员需股本至少300亿韩元
membership_structure.en: Entities holding a license for investment trading or investment brokerage business under FSCMA Article 12(1) are eligible to apply for membership; members are classified into seven types by market scope and product coverage (Securities, Equity Securities, Collective Investment Securities, Debt Securities, Derivatives, Equity Derivatives, and Currency-interest Rate Derivatives members), and further split into Settlement Members and Trading Members depending on whether they bear settlement responsibility directly; example financial thresholds: Securities + Derivatives member requires equity capital of at least KRW 40 billion and a net capital ratio of 100%+, while Securities + Equity Derivatives member requires at least KRW 30 billion

stamp_duty.zh: 韩国官方名称为「证券交易税」（Securities Transaction Tax，非「印花税」字面译法，但功能上是本项目该字段横向对比的对应项），该页表述股票证券交易税率为0.3%（并说明该税不适用于ETF）
stamp_duty.en: Officially the "Securities Transaction Tax" (not literally a stamp duty, but the functional equivalent for cross-exchange comparison in this field); this page states a 0.3% rate for stocks (and notes it is not charged on ETFs)
stamp_duty.detail: 该页聚焦ETF为何免税的场景，顺带提及股票税率0.3%，并非专门介绍证券交易税的官方税率页，未标注版本/生效日期，也未说明KOSPI/KOSDAQ是否有差异化税率或近年是否曾调整——按此单一间接来源标 medium，不标 high。

regulatory_change_risk_note.zh: KOSPI退市/管理股财务门槛正处于多年分阶段调整期：营收门槛从「2026年底前50亿韩元」逐步提高到「2027年10亿韩元」「2028年200亿韩元」（最终门槛为300亿韩元，2027年起若市值达标可豁免）；市值门槛从「2025年底前50亿韩元」提高到「2026上半年200亿韩元」「2026下半年300亿韩元」（最终门槛为500亿韩元）——这意味着同一份退市规则在不同年份对应的实际数值门槛不同，横向比较或历史数据核对时要注意抓取时点
regulatory_change_risk_note.en: KOSPI's delisting/administrative-issue financial thresholds are in a multi-year phase-in: the sales threshold rises from KRW 5bn (through 2026) to KRW 10bn (2027) to KRW 20bn (2028), with a final KRW 30bn threshold (waivable from 2027 if market cap qualifies); the market-cap threshold rises from KRW 5bn (through 2025) to KRW 20bn (H1 2026) to KRW 30bn (H2 2026), with a final KRW 50bn threshold — meaning the same delisting rule maps to different numeric thresholds depending on the year, which matters for cross-exchange comparison or historical fact-checking depending on when the data was fetched
